body: {"better": "A", "reason": "Card B has multiple issues: it omits the number of stops (5 and 3), invents 'సరసరసగా కొనుక్కోవచ్చు' (bargaining/haggling) which isn't supported by the outing details, and incorrectly says '9 నిమిషాలు నడిచి' as if that's the only walk when there are three walks (4 min, 7 min, 9 min). Card A correctly includes all stop counts, mentions 'తాజా కూరగాయలు' as a reason to enjoy (supported by farmers' market), and accurately represents the full trip including all walks implicitly through the stop sequence."}
